method: BASELINE. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: From the seat of the insured person or policy owner: what is a life policy and what a life insurer may offer (ss 9, 9A, 234, 12A as a fact); ownership and the superannuation policy (s 10, Dictionary); capacity of young persons (s 199); children's advancement policies (ss 218-220); assignment (s 200); protection from creditors (ss 204, 205); surrender, paid-up and non-forfeiture (ss 207-210); payment on death without probate (ss 211-213); no set-off (s 217); lost policy documents (s 221); suicide and war-service terms (ss 228, 229). Out: the prudential and machinery Parts (2A-9, 10A, 11 except s 234, 12), ss 198, 201-203, Division 2A, ss 214-216A, 222-227. Insurable interest and beneficiary nominations are not in this Act.
seat: the insured person or policy owner (for Chloe, the fund member whose life her fund's group cover insures)
lives: chloe c04a: income protection and life cover inside her super fund (15 September 2026)
